principles.title: Validate before building
principles.body: Focus groups, user interviews and usability testing come before engineering time is committed. At Moving Walls, that discipline cut development rework by about 30%.

principles.title: Keep reasoning and arithmetic apart
principles.body: Language models are good at interpreting, planning and explaining. Budgets, pricing and billing belong to deterministic systems. As I put it in Media Intelligence: a language model should not be your ad server.

principles.title: Report claims as what they are
principles.body: In Media Intelligence every claim is labelled as source-based, editorial synthesis or outlook. Vendor results stay vendor results, and where my own papers disagreed with each other, the magazine says so.

principles.title: Stay close to the commercial case
principles.body: My MBA was in business analysis and finance, and it keeps me anchored to the commercial side of a product decision as well as the technical one.
